definition: I. [ אוּלַי ] proper name, of a river Ulai, Eulaeus (Assyrian Ulâi , compare Dl Pa 329 Greek Εὐλαιος ) only אוּלָ֑י , river of Elam Dan 8:2 ; Dan 8:16 = (at least in lower part) modern Karûn (old Pasitigris ) see Dl Pa 177. 189. 329 ; in upper part perhaps also = modern Kerkhah (= Choaspes), which. was formerly connected with Karûn not far from Susa ( Loftus Trav. & Researches, 423 ff Schaff-Herzog iii. 2178,art. Shushan ).

I. [אוּלַי] proper name, of a river Ulai, Eulaeus (Assyrian Ulâi, compare DlPa 329 Greek Εὐλαιος) only אוּלָ֑י, river of Elam Dan 8:2; Dan 8:16 = (at least in lower part) modern Karûn (old Pasitigris) see DlPa 177. 189. 329; in upper part perhaps also = modern Kerkhah (= Choaspes), which. was formerly connected with Karûn not far from Susa (LoftusTrav. & Researches, 423 ff Schaff-Herzogiii. 2178,art.Shushan).
